stream: Autonomous Meta Remediation / Persistent Platform Authority Activation

incidentSummary.campaign: October Featured Author: Iyorwuese Hagher / A Portrait of Paradise
incidentSummary.rootCause: Meta platform publish succeeded, then the post-publish Dataverse PATCH failed because the worker attempted to write a non-existent jm1_actualcaption column. The row remained retry-eligible without a persisted platform object ID, so later worker invocations created additional Instagram media objects.

schemaInspection.captionAuthority: jm1_captionversion plus platform readback/evidence, not a Dataverse jm1_actualcaption column

observedFailure.technicalFinding: Invalid property jm1_actualcaption on jm1_socialexecution write.

canonicalKept.selectionReason: Only readable surviving A Portrait object in Instagram account media readback; exact caption match, expected destination, expected media type, and visible platform permalink.

schemaCorrection: Removed all jm1_actualcaption writes from autonomous worker path.
No jm1_publishedat write is used because the live schema uses jm1_actualschedule and jm1_verifiedat.
preclaim: Before platform publish, eligible rows are moved to PUBLISHING_CLAIMED with executor and media metadata.
Rows already in PUBLISHING_CLAIMED are reconciled before any new publish attempt.
platformIdFirstPersistence: After a successful platform publish, the worker first persists jm1_platformpostid and marks PLATFORM_OBJECT_EXISTS_DATAVERSE_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED.
A later promotion to PUBLISHED_VERIFIED is intentionally separate so the platform object ID remains anti-duplicate authority if the final certification write fails.
reconciliation: Rows in PUBLISHING_CLAIMED or PLATFORM_OBJECT_EXISTS_DATAVERSE_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED with no platformPostId are checked against recent platform objects by destination and caption prefix before publishing.
Exactly one readback match promotes the row to PUBLISHED_VERIFIED.
Multiple matches or missing matches hold the row for attention instead of publishing blindly.

currentControls.JM1_SOCIAL_EXECUTION_WORKER_CRON: 0 */1 * * * * during recovery proof; restored to 0 */15 * * * * after proof
